name: Bhagavad Gita 10.20
text:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
meaning: I am the self in the heart of all beings, Arjuna; I am their beginning, middle and end.
purpose: The divine as the self in all beings, and as beginning, middle and end.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
